name: Bright Smile Dental
greeting: Thanks for calling Bright Smile Dental, this is Ava. How can I help you today?

faq.a: Yes — there's free patient parking right in front, plus a wheelchair-accessible entrance.
We're in-network with Delta Dental PPO, MetLife, and Cigna. Cleanings and check-ups are typically covered at 100%.
Absolutely, we're welcoming new patients. A first visit is a 60-minute new-patient exam.
We're at 120 Trade Street, Suite 200, Charlotte, NC 28202.
We take all major cards, HSA/FSA cards, and offer CareCredit financing.
